the_rule: A set is one aim, one go-live day, one way of shooting. Money settles inside a set and changes nothing for anyone else. A day or a shoot mode cannot settle inside a set — other people already agreed to it — so disagreeing about either moves her OUT, into a deferred pool from which a later set is built. Every fork in the five books is a consequence of that sentence.
supersedes_note: All seven stay approved:false and are marked status:superseded, so none can back a change. Their lock.json notes are KEPT — they record the founder's corrections round by round and that history is not reproduced in the atlas.

open_questions_resolved.brand_never_confirms: SETTLED. Silence becomes confirmation after a short admin-set wait (default 3 days), with nudges on day 1 and 2. She sees the countdown too. After TWO rejections on the same channel it escalates to admin, not back to her, so "not live / wrong link" cannot become a new way to withhold. Applies to pay-for-content sets only — on a sale set the link is a reference and no money hangs on it. Rationale: the risk is lopsided. A brand who auto-confirms a bad link loses a quarter of a fee he already agreed and locked in escrow, having had 3 days and a button. A creator waiting on a button nobody must press loses money she has earned, with no recourse.
